title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-xrvk: indentation regression in std_ext FragmentReceiver
description:
Commit f2ce09c5695 introduced formatting/indentation regressions in rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs std_ext module, confirmed by cargo fmt --check:

1. FragmentReceiver::new() (lines 1103-1115): struct literal fields under-indented by one level vs the fn body
2. FragmentReceiver::receive() (lines 1178-1188): if let Some(active) block under-indented by one level (at fn declaration level instead of body level)
3. Ack construction block (lines 1232-1243): return block under-indented inside if frag.is_all_0() branch

The rule_id: u8 → Option<u8> conversion logic itself is correct (fixes pre-existing type-safety issue where struct declared Option<u8> but code treated it as u8). Only the indentation is wrong.

Fix: run cargo fmt on the file to auto-correct indentation, or manually re-indent the affected blocks.
